answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to audit transactions through topological cut verifications. If an unbonded cluster attempts fraud, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing detects boundary anomalies and triggers stake slashing, reflecting fraud back on the colluder like a mirror. Each node deposits copper or umber tier bond weights into routing pools; bypassing the topological cut incurs superlinear attacker cost as verification depth increases.
